Alex — 11:00 AM PT on Thu, Mar 18 works for us. I've updated the calendar invite (see calendar link below) and attached a parking-lot doc for the session (parking_lot_questions.md).

Quick logistics:
- Calendar: Thu Mar 18, 2026 • 11:00 AM – 12:00 PM PT (Google Meet link in invite).
- Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-arch-deep-dive (I've added a "parking-lot" section and populated initial questions).
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.app/contacts/ACME-12345 (recorded for CS/AE).

Parking-lot (initial items) — note: I'm tagging internal owners to prep short answers during the session:
1) VPN & Private Deployment: network access patterns, customer VPC peering options, and required firewall rules. (owner: dev_patel)
2) SSO / SAML / SCIM: supported identity providers, provisioning flow, and session lifetimes. (owner: laura_bennett)
3) KV cache & data retention: is KV cached state persisted to disk, retention defaults, and purging policy. (owner: dylan_brooks)
4) Encryption & KMS: at-rest encryption model, customer-managed keys options, and HSM/KMS integrations. (owner: dev_patel)
5) Audit logs & compliance evidence: SOC 2 artifacts, access logs retention, and how customers can export logs. (owner: dev_patel)
6) Observability & SLAs: per-route latency SLOs, tracing hooks, and token-level cost telemetry. (owner: laura_bennett)

Action items for internal team: please add short bullets in the shared doc against your item by EOD Mon, Mar 16 so we can reference during the call. I'll consolidate and keep the "parking-lot" section live for post-call follow-ups.

Marissa — I'll own item #3 (KV cache & data retention) and will add an initial write-up to the parking-lot doc today. Short answer for Alex: KV cache is treated as ephemeral in-host memory by default and not durably persisted; we do not store KV snapshots to customer object storage unless explicitly configured in a Private deployment pattern. I'll add notes on retention defaults and the purge TTLs we typically apply.

I'll also prepare a 5-minute demo of batching/KV behaviour for the call.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
